name: Decision Making
description: Expected value calculations, reversibility assessment (Type 1 vs Type 2), and speed under uncertainty.

dimensions.name: Reversibility & Speed (Type 1 / Type 2)
dimensions.description: Making fast two-way door decisions rapidly while slowing down for irreversible one-way doors.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Accurately categorizes door reversibility; commits quickly with 70% information.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Decisive with slight over-analysis on minor reversible matters.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Slows down on easily reversible choices; exhibits analysis paralysis.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Treats two-way doors like permanent decisions; stalls all momentum.

dimensions.name: Asymmetric Risk/Reward Analysis
dimensions.description: Limiting catastrophic downside while maximizing uncapped upside potential.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Calculates convex payoff profiles; caps downside risk strictly.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good risk-weighted decision with minor exposure to tail risk.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Takes on hidden existential risks for meager linear rewards.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Gambles on high-risk, low-reward outcomes without hedges.
